newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mostly lower in buoyant trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mostly lower in buoyant trade.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mostly lower in buoyant trade on Thursday and blue chip pharmaceutical Pliva was absent from the market for the first time in months.
* Of 11 active stocks seven fell, two rose, one was flat and one traded for the first time.
* Turnover doubled to 8.1 million kuna on a slightly smaller volume of 7,150 shares.
* Most actively traded stock was food company Podravka, closing nine kuna lower to 305 with 2,375 units sold.
* Biggest loser was cable maker Elka which fell ten kuna to 170 on volume of 1,020 shares.
* Varazdinska Banka was the bigger of two gainers, surging 12,000 kuna to 28,000 but sold only one share. It last traded in December 1996. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
